page.overview:
Who is Doll Devil?

The の|Ningyō no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of dolls.

The Doll Devil's real appearance is currently unknown. The only time it was ever physically seen was when it took over Tolka's body.

Little is known about the Doll Devil. However, they appear to be on good terms with Santa Claus, since it was willing to help her in her plan to make a deal with the Darkness Devil.

At some point Santa Claus made a contract with the Doll Devil.
